Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1160 of 2023
Applicant :- Munna Lal Gupta

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- M.P.S. Chauhan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mohd. Arshad Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.

Heard Sri M.P.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Mohd. Arshad, learned counsel for the opposite party alongwith learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Criminal Case No.12299 of 2022 arising out of Case No.359 of 2021, under sections 498A, 306 I.P.C., Police Station Bannadevi, District Aligarh, during the pendency of investigation/trial.

It is submitted that in this case applicant is father-in-law of the deceased who was weded to his son in the year 2011 but on account of mutual dispute between husband and wife she committed suicide by hanging in the year 2021 and being father of the husband of the deceased he has also been named in the F.I.R.

It is further submitted that no any kind of harassment or demand of dowry was made by the present applicant with the deceased and even in the post-mortem no any injury was found on Munna Lal Gupta vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98697396/
1 the person of the deceased except asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

entities.text: Munna Lal Gupta vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that a suicide note was also left by the deceased herself but no allegation was made against the present applicant in that note.
After investigation charge sheet has been submitted and now in pursuance of the process of the court the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
Learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perusal of record and without making any comment on the merit of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case during the pendency of trial.
In the event of arrest of the applicant- Munna Lal Gupta, shall be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned court everyday when case is fixed unless exempted;
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Ashok Gupta  Munna Lal Gupta vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98697396/
